sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r8/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 18 / check 17 'solution_covers_every_deliverable'; Internal Quality Checks row 18, no extra annotation)
evidence: Walked the brief and the three /instructions notes line by line against the frozen golden; every asked-for screen, role and flow has an implementation. Sign-in-only shell with no data (index.html:10-21, all /api routes requireUser, transcript 401 server.js:502); five seeded accounts with password123 and partner/associate/client roles (server.js:93-100,187-193); walls on list/thread/search/quote/unread/mentions/link previews/transcript/direct fetch returning 'Not available.' (server.js:189-201,226-235,250,320-323,382-391,497-505) and partner add/lift UI with live removal via 2 s polling -> showUnavailable (app.js:248-279,566-572,640-651); nested replies of any depth in send order with quote and same-matter enforcement (server.js:253-291,405-411); edits with 'edited', staff-only versions, author delete with in-place confirm/'Keep it', held-delete refusal, stale-edit 409 keeping typed text (server.js:427-455, app.js:338-345,474-487,536-553); safe formatting (*bold*, `code`, '> ' quote, http(s) links target=_blank) with escaping in thread, quote, snippets, versions and transcript (app.js:23-55,308,548,631; server.js:494-515); copyable message links with per-viewer preview/'not available' and highlight that persists until another open (server.js:224-235, app.js:312-328,525-533,583-591,241-242,297); @-mentions by first name any case, suggestions limited to people who can see the matter, edit/delete updates mention lists (server.js:209-222,339-345,441,153; app.js:427-472); server-side per-user unread, 'New messages' line, mark-unread, deleted excluded (server.js:239-245,346-360; app.js:186-196,281-293,516-524); Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape (app.js:411-422); idempotent client_key sends and seq ordering in thread/search/transcript (server.js:403-424,254,387); polling without disturbing composer/scroll/open versions (app.js:225-239,640-651); timers off/1/7/30 shown beside title, partner-only, >= age deletion, shorten sweeps, hold blocks and release sweeps (server.js:139-154,246,457-477); transcript page with number, title, generated time, threads oldest first, author/time/edited/On hold, versions for held edited, placeholder, no controls (server.js:497-518); refusals shown in place and kept until changed (app.js:355-376,486,559,568); runtime contract: __dirname-relative files, DB_PATH, 0.0.0.0:3000, health 200 even if DB fails, idempotent one-time seed, fixed clock from seed (2026-05-12T11:00:00Z), UTC display, no shipped app.db or symlinks (server.js:13-47,93-128,156-165,527-528; solve.sh). Phone layout via @media (max-width:720px) (styles.css:118-127). Actual-run evidence: scripted golden run on these exact bytes (raw-evidence-index hashes re-verified; solution file hashes match the frozen task) reports PASS for gate_constraints, all 16 functional checks, persistence before/after a real restart, and the 6 polish checks including a 390 px no-sideways-scroll check (golden-run.log). Weak-app probe: a UI-only wall or a frontend-only unread count would be a different product than the golden, which enforces both server-side, so the reference does not rely on such shortcuts; a conforming alternative (e.g. different routes/labels) is not constrained by anything in the golden that the brief does not ask for. Notes, not defects: the seed is copied to /app/seed/seed_data.json (inside /app, with /assets fallback) rather than /app root; Harriet cannot wall herself (server.js:486), a sensible reading of 'any of our staff'; the main app at 390 px and render/visual on these bytes were not measured by a configured judge run (scripted check covers the transcript page only; prior hosted v2 visual found a clipped search placeholder said to be fixed) -- that belongs to run-evidence rows and does not undermine plausibility of coverage.
